title: No-Bake Cookie Butter Delight
creator: Maryam Cotten
cookTime: No oven required; microwave the cookie butter about 30 seconds
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the crust: Crush the Biscoff cookies and combine with 2 sticks of melted butter. Set aside 2-3 tablespoons of the crumbs for the topping.
Step 2: Make the base: Press the cookie mixture evenly into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Step 3: Add cheesecake: Spread the no-bake cheesecake evenly over the cookie crust.
Step 4: Melt the cookie butter: Microwave the Biscoff cookie butter for approximately 30 seconds, until smooth and pourable.
Step 5: Add the cookie butter layer: Pour the melted cookie butter evenly over the cheesecake layer.
Step 6: Add the topping: Spread Cool Whip over the top and sprinkle with extra crushed Biscoff cookies.
Step 7: Serve and enjoy! Keep refrigerated.
notes: From a Maryam Cotten Facebook reel; the full recipe is in the reel's caption, and the on-screen title is 'No-Bake Cookie Butter Delight'.
